request.initial_prompt: Dionysus. So be it, O King! 'Tis mine to obey thine hest, Whate'er it be. Pentheus (_after hesitating once more and waiting_). Well, I will go--perchance To march and scatter them with serried lance, Perchance to take thy plan. . . . I know not yet.
